summary: New v5 mobile-battle criteria (briefing engage-btn tappability, rotate-prompt, drag box-select, formations, reinforcements, destructible cover) each got a fresh browser check; reinforcements also got a backend pytest file. Regression lane re-ran the existing retreat-autosave check. All 7 criteria exercised across 7 new browser checks (one ran twice: once on localhost, once through the public preview ingress) + 1 backend test file (5 tests) + 1 re-run of a pre-existing browser check. 7 new/rerun browser checks passed, 5 backend tests passed, 1 pre-existing regression check passed.

checks.criterion: User bug: BEGIN THE ASSAULT button pushed off-screen by the troop list on phone
checks.name: briefing-engage-btn-tappable-mobile
checks.evidence: At 390x664 portrait and (fresh context) 844x390 landscape: briefing-scroll scrolled to bottom, engage-btn boundingBox fully inside the viewport both times, click removed briefing-panel (battle started) in both viewports.

checks.criterion: User bug cross-check through public ingress
checks.name: briefing-engage-btn-tappable-mobile-preview
checks.evidence: Same flow run against https://ww2-permadeath--19wbuck3.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x664: engage-btn visible on-screen after scrolling the roster, click starts the battle (briefing-panel gone).

checks.criterion: Game plays sideways on phone after deployment (rotate prompt)
checks.name: rotate-prompt-pauses-and-clears-landscape
checks.evidence: Portrait 390x664 touch after engage: rotate-prompt visible, window.__vanguard.paused===true. Same page rotated to 844x390 (exitFullscreen before setViewportSize, per the briefing's known headless-fullscreen pitfall): rotate-prompt gone, header (a[href="/"]) hidden, combat-log hidden, engine stays paused until player resumes (intentional per spec_deviations).

checks.criterion: Mobile drag-select box (touch pointer events on battle-canvas)
checks.name: mobile-drag-select-box
checks.evidence: touch-box-select toggled window.__vanguard.touchBox=true; synthetic PointerEvent(pointerType:'touch') drag over the ally cluster selected them (selected.length>0), matching dock cards carry the #4ECDC4 selected border. Deselected, then pointerdown+450ms wait+drag (press-and-hold >350ms) also produced a non-empty selection via the engine's touchPan->marquee path.

checks.criterion: Quick formation buttons (mobile touch-formation-* and desktop formation-*, F key)
checks.name: quick-formation-buttons-mobile-and-desktop
checks.evidence: Desktop 1280x720: formation-line click -> engine.formation==='line' + #4ECDC4 active class; F key cycled to 'column'; formation-wedge after selectAll() re-formed the squad (orders>0). Mobile 390x844: touch-formation-column activated (engine.formation==='column', active class), touch-formation-spread re-formed the selected squad.

checks.name: reinforcements-cost-rp-and-counter
checks.evidence: reinforce-rifle (15 RP) and reinforce-heavy (25 RP) each deducted the exact cost from battle-rp and grew debugAllies() npc count; reinforce-btn counter went 3/3->2/3->1/3->0/3 then became disabled after the 3rd call.

checks.name: test_tscheck_battle_reinforce.py
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q test_tscheck_battle_reinforce.py -> 5 passed: POST /api/battle/reinforce rifle -> 200 {kind:rifle,cost:15,requisition:rp-15}; heavy -> 200 cost:25; wrong mission_id (op_04 while current is op_01) -> 409; kind:'tank' -> 422; draining RP below 25 then calling heavy -> 402 Insufficient requisition points.

checks.name: destructible-cover-blast-reduces-hp
checks.evidence: window.__vanguard.debugCover() sample before {count:49,hp:5390}; after debugBlast(x,y) at that sample point {count:49,hp:5048} (hp dropped, no Vite error overlay, battle-timer still live).

checks.criterion: No regression in save/battle flow (retreat files a report)
checks.name: battle-retreat-autosaves-loss
checks.evidence: Re-ran pre-existing check unchanged: retreat-btn -> debrief-panel shown, debrief-return-btn reads 'REPORT FILED — RETURN TO HQ', battles_lost incremented by 1 via /api/state poll, no console errors.
